metaTitle: Support the platform: ₹3.30 a day serves one district

title: Bringing government data to every Indian citizen
description: ForThePeople.in makes government data accessible, visual and free for all {total}+ districts in India. No paywalls. No ads. Just public data for the public.

intlNote: International supporters: we can only accept payments from within India for now. To give from outside India, send us a message on Instagram at <link>@forthepeople_in</link> and we'll arrange another way to pay.
